body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one creature within 4 units. It gains +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1.
Increase one range, radius, or numeric Echo effect by 1.

rider.title: WARD RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The warded creature is targeted by an Action. Echo: The warded creature gains +1 Defense against that Action.
